title: Evaluating ML Model Accuracy: K-Fold Cross-Validation Implementation in R

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial, and mostly welcome to the last part of this course, Part 10, Model Selection and Boosting.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學，尤其歡迎進入原課程最後的第十部分，模型選擇與提升法。

cues.en: So in this part, we will do two things.
cues.zh: 這部分會做兩件事。

cues.en: First, evaluating our model performance, and second, improving our model performance.
cues.zh: 第一，評估模型效能；第二，改善模型效能。

cues.en: And then there will be this bonus section about one of the most powerful algorithm in machine learning, which has become more and more popular, and that is called XGBoost.
cues.zh: 之後還有額外章節，介紹越來越熱門、也是最強大機器學習演算法之一的 XGBoost。

cues.en: But first, we want to be able to improve the model performance of all the machine learning models we've built in this course.
cues.zh: 先希望能改善本課程建立的所有機器學習模型效能。

cues.en: And improving the model performance can be done with a technique called model selection, that consist of choosing the best parameters of your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 可透過模型選擇技術，也就是為機器學習模型選擇最佳參數。

cues.en: Because, you know, remember, every time we built a machine learning model, well, we had two types of parameters.
cues.zh: 記得每次建立模型，都有兩類參數。

cues.en: The first type were the parameters that the model learned, that is the parameters that were changed and found optimal values by running the model.
cues.zh: 第一類是模型學到的參數，也就是執行模型時，會調整並找到最佳值的參數。

cues.en: And then the second type of parameters are the parameters that we chose ourselves.
cues.zh: 第二類則是我們自行選擇的參數。

cues.en: For example, the kernel parameter in the kernel SVM model.
cues.zh: 例如核 SVM 的 kernel 參數。

cues.en: And these parameters are called the hyperparameters.
cues.zh: 這些參數稱為超參數。

cues.en: So there is still room to improve the model because we can still choose some optimal values for these parameters.
cues.zh: 所以模型還有改善空間，仍能替這些參數選擇最佳值。

cues.en: But since these parameters are not the parameters learned by the model, then we need to figure out another way to choose these optimal values for these parameters, for the hyperparameters.
cues.zh: 但既然不是模型學到的參數，就需要另一種方法，為超參數選擇最佳值。

cues.en: And that's one of the powerful thing we'll do in this Part 10, and that will be through a very efficient technique called grid search.
cues.zh: 這是第十部分會做的重要工作，會使用非常有效率的網格搜尋技術。

cues.en: But before we start grid search, we need to optimize our way to evaluate our models.
cues.zh: 但開始網格搜尋之前，需要改善評估模型的方式。

cues.en: Because so far, what we did is split our dataset between a training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，都是將資料集分為訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And, you know, we trained our model on the training set, and we tested its performance on the test set.
cues.zh: 在訓練集訓練，在測試集測試效能。

cues.en: That's a correct way of evaluating the model performance, but that's not the best one, because we actually have the variance problem.
cues.zh: 這是正確方式，但不是最全面的，因為有變異問題。

cues.en: The variance problem can be explained by the fact that when we get the accuracy on the test set, well, if we run the model again, and test again its performance on another test set,
cues.zh: 變異問題是指，取得測試集準確率後，重新執行模型，在另一個測試集評估，

cues.en: well, we can get a very different accuracy.
cues.zh: 可能得到非常不同的準確率。

cues.en: So, judging our model performance only on one accuracy, on one test set, is actually not super relevant.
cues.zh: 所以只憑一個測試集的一次準確率判斷效能，不夠有代表性。

cues.en: That's not the most relevant way to evaluate the model performance.
cues.zh: 不是最全面的評估方法。

cues.en: And so there is this technique called, k-fold cross validation that improves this a lot, because that will fix this variance problem.
cues.zh: k 折交叉驗證可以大幅改善，處理這個變異問題。

cues.en: And how will it fix it?
cues.zh: 怎麼處理？

cues.en: It will fix it by splitting the training set into ten fold when k equals 10, and most of the time k equals 10, and we train our model on nine fold,
cues.zh: 當 k = 10，就將訓練集分成 10 折，通常 k 選 10，並用 9 折訓練，

cues.en: and we test it on the last remaining fold.
cues.zh: 在剩餘的最後 1 折測試。

cues.en: And since with 10 folds, we can make 10 different combinations of nine folds to train the model, and one fold to test it, that means that we can train the model and test the model on 10 combinations
cues.zh: 10 折可以組成 10 種「9 折訓練、1 折測試」的組合，因此可以在 10 組

cues.en: of training and test sets.
cues.zh: 訓練與測試資料上訓練、測試模型。

cues.en: And that will already give us a much better idea of the model performance, because what we can do afterwards is take an average of the different accuracies of the 10 evaluations,
cues.zh: 這能更了解模型效能，因為之後可以平均 10 次評估的不同準確率，

cues.en: and also compute the standard deviation to have a look at the variance.
cues.zh: 也計算標準差，看看變異。

cues.en: So, eventually, our analysis will be much more relevant.
cues.zh: 最後分析更有意義。

cues.en: And besides, we'll know in which of these four categories we'll be.
cues.zh: 也能知道落在四種情況中的哪一類。

cues.en: Because if we get a good accuracy and a small variance, we'll be on the lower left one.
cues.zh: 準確率高、變異小，就是左下角。

cues.en: If we get a large accuracy and a high variance, we will be on the lower right one.
cues.zh: 準確率高、變異大，就是右下角。

cues.en: If we get a small accuracy and a low variance, we will be on the upper left one.
cues.zh: 準確率低、變異小，就是左上角。

cues.en: And eventually, if we get a low accuracy and a high variance, we will be on the upper right one.
cues.zh: 最後，準確率低、變異大，就是右上角。

cues.en: So this k-fold cross validation is very useful.
cues.zh: 所以 k 折交叉驗證很有用。

cues.en: And besides, our performance analysis is much more relevant.
cues.zh: 效能分析也更有代表性。

cues.en: So let's start with this k-fold cross validation, our first technique of model selection.
cues.zh: 開始第一項模型選擇技術，k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: So, since we already built a lot of models, we're not gonna build another one.
cues.zh: 既然已建立很多模型，就不再建新模型。

cues.en: We are gonna use one of the model we built and apply k-fold cross validation on it.
cues.zh: 使用之前其中一個模型，套用 k 折交叉驗證。

cues.en: And so, the model we're gonna use is this kernel SVM we made in part three classification.
cues.zh: 會使用第三部分分類的核 SVM。

cues.en: And that, remember, we used to predict if the customers are going to click on the add on the social network to buy, yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 記得它預測顧客是否會點社群網路廣告，進而購買 SUV。

cues.en: So, the model is already built and we already have everything.
cues.zh: 模型已建立，所需內容都有。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is take the whole model and we are going to add a new section code inside of it, that is going to be, of course, the section code
cues.zh: 所以取用整份模型，加入新的程式碼區段，當然就是

cues.zh: 實作 k 折交叉驗證的區段。

cues.zh: 開始之前，選正確資料夾作為工作目錄。

cues.en: So we go to Machine Learning A-Z, we are now in the last part of this course, congratulations for reaching it, Part 10, Model Selection and Boosting, and Section 48, Model Selection.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z，現在是原課程最後一部分，恭喜走到這裡，Part 10 Model Selection & Boosting，再進入 Section 48 Model Selection。

cues.en: Well, since that consists of evaluating the model performance, while the most relevant location to put it is right after we build our kernel SVM model,

cues.en: That is actually a first way of evaluating the model.
cues.zh: 這是第一種評估方式。

cues.en: But as said at the beginning of this tutorial, this is a correct way of evaluating the model but not the best one.
cues.zh: 開頭說過，它正確，但不是最全面。

cues.en: And in today's tutorial, we are introducing a much better way to evaluate our model.
cues.zh: 今天介紹更全面的評估方式。

cues.en: And so, let's put it right after this section as in a more advanced performance evaluation method.
cues.zh: 所以放在這段後面，作為更進階的效能評估方法。

cues.en: And so, we're gonna call this section, Applying k-fold Cross Validation.
cues.zh: 區段命名為 Applying k-fold Cross Validation。
